description: Shinobi is a free, open-source Network Video Recorder (NVR) and CCTV platform written in Node.js, supporting RTSP/ONVIF IP cameras, motion detection, object detection plugins, and a web/mobile-friendly viewer. This stack deploys Shinobi alongside its required MariaDB database.
name: shinobi
note: After deploying, open the Super User Panel to create your first account/API key, then add a monitor pointed at your camera's RTSP stream (e.g. rtsp://IP-CAM/ch0_0.h264).
title: Shinobi CCTV
